venues.summary: Only events@minettataverndc.com (private events, no person name) plus info@/press@. Apollo DC org (6aeee4bd...) has 0 people; 'Minetta Tavern' name hit is the NYC original (minettatavernny.com), rejected. No GM or events manager named on the site or in press/LinkedIn snippets. Better contact_form is the venue's own Tripleseat page /private-events (the sheet has bare tripleseat.com).

Site shows only info@elenajamescc.com (general, rejected); private dining page (/blank-3) sends to the Book Event form /blank-1. Owners are Colin McClimans and Danilo Simic (Nina May / Opal group) per RAMW and Washingtonian, but no email on the venue domain. Apollo org has 0 people; the pipeline's Apollo 'Elena' hits were unrelated people.

WRONG WEBSITE + not a gig venue: edmondjsafra.org is the Edmond J. Safra Philanthropic Foundation (Apollo org in Skokie IL; all the off-domain emails come from its press PDFs). The Lodge itself is the free NIH Clinical Center patient-family residence in Bethesda (cc.nih.gov, team inbox cc-famlodge@cc.nih.gov, no named person). Recommend parking/excluding the venue.

Single-page site (phone/address only, no email, no staff); Apollo org matches but has 0 people; web searches found no owner/manager name. keratsinikitchen@outlook.com (from social) not shown on the site and no name attached, so not usable.

Site is a Slice template (phone/address only). Apollo's 'Alfio's La Trattoria' org uses skipsdc.com (Skip's On The Avenue, DC), and alfios.com now 301-redirects to skipsdc.com, so it's a different business: rejected, and alfios@alfios.com is off-domain with no name. No owner/manager found on the web.

The hotel's own site publishes two named kimptonhotels.com (Kimpton management/brand domain) contacts: Kathleen Nowak, Director of Sales & Marketing (weddings page) and Audrey Washington, Catering & Conference Services Manager (social events page). The pipeline rejected both as off-domain; they should save with allow_off_domain. Apollo Hotel Rouge org has only receptionist/cook/controller (masked), none matched. Note: the instagram on file (instagram.com/kimpton) is the brand account, not this property.
